map.由两期 GDP 求增长率: Finding the growth rate from two periods of GDP
map.输入本期与基期 GDP，求增长率。: Enter the current-period and base-period GDP to get the growth rate.
map.📖 查看「由两期 GDP 求增长率 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Finding the Growth Rate from Two Periods of GDP Usage Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：由两期 GDP 求增长率: 📚 Deep Dive: Finding the Growth Rate from Two Periods of GDP
map.增速测算：录入本期与基期 GDP，算增长率。: Growth measurement: enter the current-period and base-period GDP to compute the growth rate.
map.算真实增速，剔除价格。: to compute real growth, stripping out prices.
map.教学演示：演示名义高增可能只是通胀。: Teaching demo: show that high nominal growth may be nothing but inflation.
map.示例：本期 102、基期 100，增长率=2%。: Example: a current period of 102 and a base period of 100 give a growth rate of 2%.
map.看真实产出用实际 GDP 增速（剔通胀），名义增速含价格水分。结果仅作经济学教学: For real output use real GDP growth (inflation stripped out); nominal growth contains price effects. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.同比还是环比？: Year on year or quarter on quarter?
map.年度多用同比，季度常折年率环比，口径不同勿混。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算参考，: Annual figures usually use year-on-year growth, quarterly ones often annualized quarter-on-quarter; do not mix the two bases. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.连续两季实际 GDP 环比负增常定义为准衰退，以官方裁定为准。结果仅作经济学教学: Two consecutive quarters of negative real GDP growth is often defined as a technical recession, subject to the official determination. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
